```{r data}
#Bringing in the data
behavior <- read.csv("behavior_data.csv")
covariates <- read.csv("covariates.csv")

#occupancy data, site x day for occurrences in plot
behavior$Plot <- factor(behavior$Plot, levels=c(unique(behavior$Plot), "YPC2"))
behavior_data_in <- xtabs(In_Plot_Binary ~ Plot + Date, behavior)
inplot <- ifelse(as.matrix(behavior_data_in) > 0,1,0)

#out of plot
behavior_data_out <- xtabs(Out_Plot_Binary ~ Plot + Date, behavior)
outplot <- ifelse(as.matrix(behavior_data_out) > 0,1,0)

#Covariates
habtype <- as.numeric(as.factor(covariates$HabitatType))#1= bottomland hardwood, 2= upland hardwood, 3=young pine, 4= mature pine, 5= open pasture
treatment <- as.numeric(as.factor(covariates$Treatment)) #1=control, 2=fence
nSites <- nrow(inplot)
nVisits <- ncol(inplot)
```

```{r JAGS}
#IN PLOT
library(jagsUI)
jags.data_in <- list(y=as.matrix(inplot), treatment=treatment, habtype=habtype,
nSites=nSites, nOccasions=nVisits)

#Initial values
jags.inits <- function() {
  list(beta0=rnorm(1), alpha0=rnorm(1), z=rep(1, nSites))
}
#Parameters to monitor
jags.pars <- c("beta0", "beta_treatment", "beta_habtype",
               "alpha0", "alpha_treatment",
               "sitesOccupied")
#MCMC
library(coda)
jags.g.post.samples_in <- jags.basic(data=jags.data_in, inits=jags.inits,
                                parameters.to.save=jags.pars,
                                model.file="Pate_occupancy_jags_FirstDraft.jag",
                                n.chains=3, n.adapt=100, n.burnin=0,
                                n.iter=2000, parallel=FALSE)

summary(jags.g.post.samples_in)

```
```{r JAGS 2}
library(jagsUI)
jags.data_out <- list(y=as.matrix(outplot), treatment=treatment, habtype=habtype,
nSites=nSites, nOccasions=nVisits)

#Initial values
jags.inits <- function() {
  list(beta0=rnorm(1), alpha0=rnorm(1), z=rep(1, nSites))
}
#Parameters to monitor
jags.pars <- c("beta0", "beta_treatment", "beta_habtype",
               "alpha0", "alpha_treatment",
               "sitesOccupied")
#MCMC
library(coda)
jags.g.post.samples_out <- jags.basic(data=jags.data_out, inits=jags.inits,
                                parameters.to.save=jags.pars,
                                model.file="Pate_occupancy_jags_FirstDraft.jag",
                                n.chains=3, n.adapt=100, n.burnin=0,
                                n.iter=2000, parallel=FALSE)

summary(jags.g.post.samples_out)

```
